resources.string: Built from %1$d fast charges. Solid line: the one the route plan uses (what was learned, blended with the factory curve); dashed: the factory curve; dots: what was seen in each 5 %% band.
It will fill in with your fast charges (%1$d so far): each 5 %% band needs at least 3 charges where the car, not the charger, set the power. Meanwhile the route plan uses the factory curve (dashed).
On 400–500 V chargers: you charge at %1$s %% of the power (%2$d charges; the plan assumed 50 %%).
The route plan already uses this instead of half.
Chargers of 150 kW or more: average peak %1$s kW (%2$s %% of what they could give you: the advertised power or what your car takes, whichever is lower; %3$d charges).
With at least 3 charges on chargers of 150 kW or more (or, on the 800 V C10, on 400–500 V ones) you will see here how they really perform.
Use my curve in the route plan
